title: Dye for the people!
description: This mod adds 5 new block types which can each be dyed in 16 million colours by merging minecraft dyes, like you would with leather armour
body: Dye for the people introduces 5 new block types including solid blocks, transparent blocks, carpets and glass panes, each of which can be dyed into 16 million colours (full RGB set) for use in pixel art and similar projects.
